answer.rationale: Primary expires in 14 days with no auto-renew while the line sits at 94% with no buffer, so a primary cutover cannot be a guarded test and would raise delivery risk even though memory_c2 reports a clean low-cost move last year. The low-cost quote that meets the 18% mandate is therefore leverage, not an automatic switch. memory_c4 and memory_c1 support benchmarking the incumbent at renewal to recover price and terms without migration or delivery interruption. memory_c5 does not apply: this is critical supply, not a deferrable non-critical service. It is unknown whether the incumbent will concede a full 18%, so the single action this cycle is a standard renewal negotiation rather than switch, second-source, or defer.
